messages:
noah (Finance): Heads-up: Partner CloudNorth says they didn't receive commission on a big Azure Reserved Instance purchase booked via Azure Marketplace (invoice AZ-RES-2026-241). Partner expected reseller payout of USD 15,600 but our settlement shows zero. @tara @liam please check.
tara (Partner Ops): I see the reservation was onboarded but partner_credited flag = false on the reservation record. Looks like an onboarding script missed partner mapping for reserved SKUs. @billing-bot can you pull settlement rows for CloudNorth Mar 1-31?
billing-bot: Query complete. Found reservation sale AZR-7752 amount USD 78,000 with partner_commission_pct=20 but partner_credited=false. Missing commission = USD 15,600. Created ticket FIN-4001. Uploaded CSV to drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/cloudnorth-azr-7752.csv
liam (Sales): Partner is chasing payout; they need funds by their month-end disbursement. They want us to push the commission to their ledger and not wait for Azure re-bill.
maria (RevOps): Operationally we can post an internal settlement payment to partner (one-off payout) and then reconcile with Azure settlements later. Need Finance approval for payout and revenue impact. Also need partner signed confirmation that they accept Redwood payout in lieu of Azure settlement.
anoah (Finance): (typo) noah (Finance): Agree. Draft payment memo and GL mapping. Propose GL 4240 (Partner commissions payable) and provisional expense booking with ticket FIN-4001.
alex (Accounting): For revenue recognition, we should record the commission payout as contra-revenue or partner expense depending on contract terms. Need contract excerpt. Tara please attach reseller agreement clause for reserved instance commissions.
tara (Partner Ops): Uploaded reseller agreement excerpt and onboarding logs: https://redwood.internal/drive/cloudnorth-reseller-agreement.pdf. It confirms 20% commission on reserved purchases. Also attached partner email requesting payout.
maria (RevOps): Draft payout memo:

``
Settlement payout to CloudNorth (partner id CN-88)
Amount: USD 15,600
Reason: Commission unpaid for Azure Reserved Instance sale AZR-7752 due to partner_credited flag missing on onboarding record (Mar 2026).
Related invoice/settlement: AZ-RES-2026-241 / AZR-7752
GL code: 4240 (Partner commissions payable)
Internal ticket: FIN-4001
Attachments: reseller agreement excerpt, onboarding logs
``

Approvers: @noah, @ana (Finance Lead).
anoah (Finance): (fix) noah (Finance): Approved pending Finance Lead sign-off.
nana (Finance Lead): (typo) ana (Finance Lead): Approved. Please process one-off payout and tag entries as provisional pending Azure settlement reconciliation. :white_check_mark:
maria (RevOps): Will create payment request to Treasury for USD 15,600 and post provisional journal JNL-5012. Billing-bot will link FIN-4001 when done.
billing-bot: Provisional journal posted JNL-5012, payment request PR-6601 created, FIN-4001 linked. Treasury instructed to expedite. ETA payment 2 business days.
noah (Finance): I'll note the adjustment in month-close workbook and schedule follow-up to reconcile when Azure responds. Thanks team.
tara (Partner Ops): Notified partner that payout is in process and attached ticket. :thumbsup:
